verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a SaaS messaging platform, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence shows Customer.io offers a self-hosted or on-prem deployment of its core product. The synthetic-email relay for data residency is an adjacent workaround, and the community open-source alternative is a different product, so neither counts toward this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
